parts.text: $CQP Q3 2026: revenue $2.5B, +7% Y/Y, driven by favorable pricing effects associated with LNG volumes delivered. Operating margin reached 29.4% for the period. #earnings #utilities

$WTW Q3 2026: Revenue $2.5B, +8% Y/Y, led by Health Wealth And Career as the largest segment. Operating margin 17.4% as total costs grew slightly faster than revenue amid softening market conditions. #earnings #insurance
$XPO Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $2.4B, +12% Y/Y, driven by the North American Less-Than-Truckload segment. Operating margin 12.1%; operating cash flow $415M. #earnings #industrials
$AVY Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $2.3B, +5% Y/Y, driven by mid-single-digit organic growth in high-value categories. Operating margin 10.3%; operating cash flow $299M. #earnings #materials
$AMZN Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $201.9B, +12% Y/Y, driven by AWS segment growth. Operating margin reached 13.9%. #earnings #ecommerce
$GILD Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $8.3B, +7% Y/Y, driven by higher HIV sales led by Biktarvy. Operating margin 41.7%. #earnings #biotech
$XEL Q3 2026: revenue $4.2B, +7% Y/Y, driven by growth in contracts with customers. Operating margin 28.5%; operating cash flow $2.1B. #earnings #utilities
$NTRS Q3 2026: revenue $2.3B, +13% Y/Y, driven by higher trust, investment, and servicing fees from favorable markets alongside net interest income. Operating margin 34.7%. #earnings #banks

$INTC Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue reached $16.5B, +21% Y/Y, driven by its strongest data center revenue growth in 15 years and robust CPU demand. Operating margin was 15.3%. #earnings #semiconductors
$INGM Q3 2026: revenue $15.2B, +21% Y/Y, driven by growth in advanced and cloud-based solutions. Operating margin 1.9%; net earnings $131M. Operating cash flow $251M. #earnings #industrials
$WKC Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $13.3B, +41% Y/Y, with an operating margin of 0.6%, driven by aviation segment expansion. #earnings #industrials
$SNDK Q1 FY27 (preliminary): revenue $11.0B, +378% Y/Y, driven by robust demand and growth in the data center business. Operating margin 79.6%; operating cash flow $6.4B. #earnings #tech
